pages.headline: Taylor, thank you.
pages.pull_quote: Strong coverage for the house and everything in it, at a price that holds.
paragraphs: Thank you for letting us quote your home at 300 Placeholder Court. Travelers came back with a solid policy at $1,984.00 for the year.
It insures the house for $420,000, plus 25% more if rebuilding costs run over, with $300,000 of personal liability and water back-up coverage included.
Call or email me when you're ready, and we can bind the same day.

pages.headline: What this policy won't cover.
pages.lede: Every homeowners policy has exclusions and limits. Here are the ones worth knowing before you bind.

common.title: Flood
common.text: Homeowners policies never cover flood. Flood insurance is a separate policy we can quote.

common.title: Water back-up
common.text: Sewer or sump back-up is capped at $10,000.

common.title: Wear and upkeep
common.text: Damage from age, wear, or lack of maintenance is not covered.

callout.title: Closing the gaps
callout.text: Flood insurance and a higher water back-up limit can usually be added. Ask us for a price before you bind.

pages.fine: This is a summary of what the quote lists, not the full policy. The policy contract controls.

sections.title: Your home
rows: Pays to rebuild the house itself: walls, roof, floors, built-ins. The limit is based on rebuilding cost, not what the home would sell for.
Covers your belongings, paid at what it costs to buy the item new.
Liability pays your legal defense and any judgment if someone is hurt on your property. Med pay covers a guest's small medical bills quickly.
Standard policies exclude water from a backed-up drain or failed sump pump. This fills that gap.
